entity.name: Lilium Jet — Saudia Group Sales Agreement
entity.meta_description: Saudia and Lilium signed a binding sales agreement on 18 July 2024 for up to 100 Lilium Jets. Lilium filed final insolvency 21 February 2025; prototypes scrapped April 2026. Contract orphaned.

sources.name: Lilium IR — Saudia Group Signs Industry-Leading Sales Agreement With Lilium to Acquire Up to 100 eVTOL Jets (18 Jul 2024) (archived copy)
The National — German air taxi developer Lilium files for insolvency again (22 Feb 2025)
FlightGlobal — Lilium Jet's journey ends on scrapheap as prototypes fail to sell (9 Apr 2026)
